name: getcolors-invariant-knowledge-graph
description: Proprietary database of software packaging invariants, kernel optimizations, cloud-native storage rules, and failure remediations.

invariants.context: Apache Kafka KRaft 3-node cluster with high write throughput on AWS Graviton3 (c7g / m6g)
invariants.defect: High P99 latency caused by Linux kernel dirty background writeback stalls and unaligned cross-socket NUMA memory accesses.

invariants.context: ClickHouse Keeper + 3-Node Raft cluster on bare-metal NVMe drives
invariants.defect: Keeper fsync lock contention during heavy background merges when Raft log shares disk with data parts.

invariants.context: PostgreSQL 16 HA with Patroni on GCP Compute Engine using Hyperdisk Balanced
invariants.defect: Unpredictable WAL flush latency spikes due to default transparent hugepage defragmentation.
